subject: Acceptance & billing sprint: Orion Health marketplace purchase
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@orionhealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <r.menon@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acceptance & billing sprint: Orion Health marketplace purchase

Hi Sara / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our discussion, I put together a focused sprint to close the marketplace private-offer commitment and get your acceptance gates completed within the next 10 business days. High level asks below and a draft MAP attached (mutual-action-plan-v2.xlsx).

Summary of target steps (short sprint):
- Day 0–2: Security/compliance evidence & procurement questionnaire (you) + Redwood provides SOC2 audit page + KMS/HSM notes.
- Day 2–5: Technical acceptance (demo checklist + smoke tests); Karthik will run the eval script and capture results.
- Day 4–7: PO issuance & AWS Marketplace private-offer creation (we draft the private-offer terms and billing mapping).
- Day 7–10: Invoice routing + finance mapping + final signoff and production enablement.

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm procurement POC and billing contact (name + email) who will receive the vendor invoice mapping doc.
2) Return the procurement questionnaire (attached) by EOD Fri so legal can begin parallel review.
3) Agree acceptance criteria below so we can lock the eval run:
   - Demo walkthrough: latency within 300ms p95 for 512 tokens on our dedicated SKU.
   - Two canonical prompt tests pass (I provided them in the MAP).

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-v2.xlsx (MAP), orion-procurement-questionnaire.pdf

I'll follow up with a short kickoff invite once we have the billing contact.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@orionhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <r.menon@orionhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acceptance & billing sprint: Orion Health marketplace purchase

Hi Olga —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick items from procurement/legal/finance side:

1) Procurement POC: Rajiv Menon (r.menon@orionhealth.com) — he is on copy. Finance billing contact for vendor mapping: finance-payments@orionhealth.com (we'll add the person later).
2) Timeline: We can aim for your Day 0–10 window but need legal review to run in parallel. I'll target getting the completed procurement questionnaire back by Friday COB.
3) Marketplace notes: our finance team prefers the private-offer invoice to flow via AWS Marketplace (they require the marketplace invoice + company billing ID mapped). Can you confirm Redwood will include marketplace billing metadata and the AWS AMI ID (or equivalent) on the invoice?
4) Acceptance criteria: The demo checklist you sent looks good — two asks: include a test that validates tokenization parity for our constrained prompts, and add a steps list in the MAP for how the KV cache warmup should be run.

Attaching: completed procurement questionnaire (attached as orion-procurement-questionnaire.pdf).

We also need DocuSign for the PO/ordering doc — please send when ready.

Regards,
Sara Lim
Senior Procurement Manager
Orion Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@orionhealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acceptance & billing sprint: Orion Health marketplace purchase

Sara / Olga —

Thanks — looping the technical checklist and our proposed eval run cadence here. Per the MAP, technical acceptance will be split into:

1) Smoke run (2 hours): basic throughput and latency checks on the dedicated SKU. I will run this against your representative prompts (please confirm tokenized examples).
2) Regression run (1 day): the two canonical prompt suites, plus tokenization parity check (I added steps in the MAP).
3) KV cache warmup: we'll provide a reproducible script (attached in the MAP) and capture cold vs warm p95.

Private-offer flow notes: once we receive the PO and the finance billing ID, Redwood will request the AWS Marketplace private-offer creation. That step requires your AWS Marketplace account ID + the finance billing group. We will not create the private offer until we confirm the billing mapping to the account ID you provide.

JIRA for acceptance artifacts: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8742 — please upload acceptance logs and test outputs there (I will create the ticket and share permissions).

Attachments referenced: aws-private-offer-checklist.pdf (checklist), mutual-action-plan-v2.xlsx (steps + scripts).

Let me know the tokenized prompt samples and I will schedule the smoke run.

—Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@orionhealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <r.menon@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acceptance & billing sprint: Orion Health marketplace purchase — final notes

Sara / Rajiv —

Great progress this week — thanks for the completed questionnaire and quick turnaround. Final summary and immediate next steps so nothing slips: 

Action items (owner / due):
- Orion: confirm AWS Marketplace account ID + finance billing group (owner: Rajiv) — due Mon 11/13 EOD.
- Orion: sign & return the PO via DocuSign (I'll send link) — target Tue 11/14.
- Redwood (Karthik): run smoke acceptance once tokenized prompts are uploaded — target Wed 11/15.
- Redwood (Olga/Laura): request AWS private-offer creation and map invoice routing once PO + account ID are confirmed.

I am sending a short DocuSign envelope for the PO now (docusign-invoice-routing-link.txt) and a kickoff invite for Monday to align finance + engineering (https://calendly.com/redwood-sales/marketplace-kickoff-30).

If anything in the MAP needs changing I can push an updated spreadsheet — otherwise we'll treat the attached MAP and checklists as authoritative for the sprint.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you into production quickly.

Olga Petrov
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
